briefTitle: Phase 1 Study of OP-3136 in Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Age minimum is listed in the study metadata but not explicitly written in the eligibility criteria text provided.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer, mCRPC, or NSCLC (Part 1)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The study includes multiple tumor types and cohort-specific rules that cannot be reduced to a single typed NSCLC stage or biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with advanced/metastatic, symptomatic, visceral spread, that are at risk of life-threatening complications in the short term.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic visceral spread with risk of complications is a clinical judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known active or symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases, carcinomatous meningitis, leptomeningeal disease, or a spinal cord compression that require CNS-specific treatment, or participants who did not demonstrate clinical and radiologic stability during the last 2 months prior to the first dose of study treatment or require or are currently on steroid therapy for CNS metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The complex criteria combining symptoms, stability duration, and steroid use cannot be cleanly mapped to a single allowedBrainMets category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer, mCRPC, or NSCLC (Part 1) or advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- BC or mCRPC (Part 2).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility criteria differ across multiple study parts (Part 1 vs Part 2) and target multiple distinct tumor types, making a single typed rule inapplicable.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 1B (Dose escalation for OP-3136 in combination with fulvestrant): Participants with advanced or metastatic ER+ HER2- breast cancer that have progressed on or after at least 1 prior line of treatment that included endocrine therapy and CDK 4/6 inhibitor in advanced or metastatic setting and must have received no more than 2 prior lines of endocrine therapy...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lines of therapy and specific combinations required vary extensively across different study cohorts and parts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with advanced/metastatic, symptomatic, visceral spread, that are at risk of life-threatening complications in the short term.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic visceral spread risk is a subjective clinical assessment rather than a structured lab or biomarker check.
